design.purpose: A thick striped seat pad for one chair or stool, about 40 × 32 cm, made from the two photographed chunky yarns. Confirm enough yarn for about 40 × 32 cm before starting; yardage cannot be judged from skein size.

steps.c: Place green yarn ready to work from the ball.
Place blue yarn beside the green yarn.
Ch 21 with green yarn: 20 stitches plus 1 turning chain.
Row 1: sc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch across, 20 sc.
Rows 2–8: ch 1, turn, 20 sc in green on each row.
Cut green yarn, leaving a 15 cm tail.
Row 9: join blue, ch 1, turn, 20 sc across.
Rows 10–16: ch 1, turn, 20 sc in blue on each row.
Fasten off and cut blue yarn, leaving a 15 cm tail.
Weave the blue tail under and over stitches, then back.
Weave the green tail in the opposite direction and trim excess.
